title: Keep Building Without Getting Paid
partialText: The best developers don’t stop building when they close the laptop. In an age of agents, your hobby might be the most irreplaceable thing about you.

title: AI UX Patterns for User Control
partialText: When users are working with our AI tools, they need to know that they are still ultimately the ones in the driver’s seat.

title: The Six Questions Every AI Trace Should Be Able to Answer
partialText: To be useful, an AI trace should explain what the agent decided, what data it used, what it cost or whether the output was any good. Progress AI Observability Platform does this for teams building in Python, .NET. and JavaScript/TypeScript.

title: Telerik UI for Blazor TaskBoard for Enterprise Workflows
partialText: See how the Blazor TaskBoard can equip your app with a handy Kanban-style visualized workflow.

title: Understanding Race Conditions in ASP.NET Core
partialText: Explore the concept of race conditions in ASP.NET Core, understand how to identify them in practice and learn strategies to protect applications against this type of issue.

title: Building an Onboarding and Registration UI in .NET MAUI
partialText: See how to use LinearGradientBrush and RadialGradientBrush, structure grid layouts and create a dynamic form using the Telerik DataForm in .NET MAUI.

title: AI UX Patterns for User Clarity
partialText: The more insights we can give our users about what our software is doing and what they can expect to happen next, the more comfortable they will feel engaging with our AI features.

title: Creating a Production-Ready CRUD Application in ASP.NET Core
partialText: Are you a beginner looking to create a portfolio to impress recruiters? Or perhaps an experienced developer looking to build better basic apps ready to evolve? Learn how to create a CRUD application in ASP.NET Core that goes beyond the basics and has everything you need to stand out in the real world.

title: Simplify Hierarchical Selection in Blazor with the Telerik DropDownTree
partialText: The Blazor DropDownTree allows you to show hierarchy for data like product searches or organization and department structures down to individual employees, with options for expansion and collapse and breadcrumb displays.

title: Query Keys: Patterns for Scaling TanStack Query
partialText: Check out what might be the cleanest way to manage query keys at scale, patterns to use and why this an underrated part of using TanStack Query.

title: 4 Rating Card UI Ideas in .NET MAUI
partialText: Enable users to provide feedback rating with these four variations of rating cards for your .NET MAUI app.

title: Biometric Authentication in Angular Using Auth0
partialText: Learn to build an authentication system that supports passkeys using the Auth0 SDK within an Angular application.

title: AI UX Patterns for User Trust
partialText: AI is still a black box to many users. If they don’t understand how AI works, it’s hard to trust the output. These UX patterns can help build user trust.

title: AI Prompt Cookbook for React Developers
partialText: These 10 prompts can help React developers get immediate value from AI features in Progress KendoReact. Plus, learn about the techniques for why some prompts work well.

title: Using AI to Build a Blazor App 4: Architect and Build the First Feature
partialText: How do you get AI to iteratively work on your feature without losing track of its progress? Give it a way to track its progress!
